name: 42938-longdecode-30ba3b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, `mp` executor. 63.2 GB of bf16 weights plus this operating point's KV and Mamba state does not fit one H100 80GB.
architecture: Mamba2-hybrid sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (NemotronHForCausalLM): 52 layers, 31.6B parameters bf16, ~3B active per token, 2 KV heads at head_dim 128.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, bounded at 128 requests with a 10800 s safety cap. No warmup and no cooldown: one request per stream, so a warmup percentage would drop whole streams. Seed static 42938.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, plain completion format (no chat template): 4096 prompt tokens and 16384 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0, `ignore_eos: true` (weights are random placeholders, so EOS carries no meaning).
purpose: A long-form report generator writing 60,000-token drafts from short briefs for 128 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# Engine settings for this deployment. Keys are AsyncEngineArgs fields with hyphens.

model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16
tensor-parallel-size: 2
distributed-executor-backend: mp

# Weights are randomly initialised in place and the 63 GB checkpoint is never downloaded, so the
# generated text is meaningless: the client pins the output length and ignores EOS.
load-format: dummy

# The checkpoint ships an `auto_map`.
trust-remote-code: true

# A request is 4096 prompt + 16384 output = 20480 tokens; the ceiling is set well above it.
max-model-len: 65536
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
async-scheduling: true
reasoning-parser: nemotron_v3
generation-config: vllm
